It's probably worth putting a breakpoint in `iree_hal_hip_semaphore_fail` . 9 times out of 10 that issue comes from an OOM.
This is an asynchronous error, so we likely need quite a bit more context to figure out what is going on.

Also the standard questions apply.
1) Is anyone else using the machine (or are there any other rogue processes holding onto GPU memory)
2) If no, check rocm-smi and check the vram usage before you start, it should be 0 across the board, if not, something is using up some memory.
3) If you `watch -n0 rocm-smi` while your application is running, does it get very close to the memory limit before it crashes.

I looked at this with @bangtianliu some, it looks like that particular machine has an unknown version of rocm on it.
Can we install the same version as the SharkMi300X, 6.3.3 which is the latest public.
@AWoloszyn with 6.3.3, I don't see issue with iree-benchmar-module but when running MLPerf harness for BS-48/56, it's failing during iree-compilation but working fine with 6.5
I am not sure why a change in rocm version would cause compilation issues, I didn't think rocm was even used during the compilation step. Is there any output?
